category_title: Students with severe disabilities receiving one-on-one paraeducator instruction
scenario_title: Passive disengagement during independent silent reading
minimal_context: The student is sitting at their desk in the general education classroom with an adapted book for a silent reading activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our silent reading activity. Your adapted book is right here on your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around the classroom while many other students are talking quietly.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go ahead and start reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares straight ahead, leaving the adapted book closed on the desk.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to open your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The book remains closed while the student continues to stare straight ahead and look around the classroom.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our silent reading activity. Your adapted book is right here on your desk.

STUDENT: (Looks around the classroom while many other students are talking quietly.)

TUTOR: Please go ahead and start reading.

STUDENT: (Stares straight ahead, leaving the adapted book closed on the desk.)

TUTOR: You need to open your book.

STUDENT: (The book remains closed while the student continues to stare straight ahead and look around the classroom.)
